title: Democratic socialist Melat Kiros poised to become the first Gen Z woman in Congress
description: Kiros, a political newcomer, topped 15-term-incumbent Diana DeGette in the Democratic primary in Colorado's 1st Congressional District, a reliably blue House seat.

title: The 2026 FIFA World Cup schedule and how to watch
description: With 104 World Cup games being played in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, it's like "a Super Bowl every single day for five weeks," U.S. team captain Tim Ream told CBS News.

title: Phil Weiser projected to win Democratic primary for Colorado governor
description: Colorado Attorney General Phil Weiser is the winner in the pivotal race to be the Democratic nominee for governor in Colorado, AP projects.

title: Democratic socialist Melat Kiros topples a nearly 30-year incumbent to win Colorado House primary
description: The 29-year-old DSA-backed challenger ousted Rep. Diana DeGette, one of Colorado’s longest-serving Democrats, in the primary for the 1st District.

title: Socialism goes west as DSA-backed challenger ousts longtime Democrat
description: Rep. Diana DeGette is defeated by a DSA-backed socialist challenger Melat Kiros in Colorado's Democratic primary, scoring a victory for the far-left's momentum.

title: E. Jean Carroll attorneys say 'time for him to pay' after SCOTUS rejects Trump appeal
description: The U.S. Supreme Court this week, with no dissents, declined to hear President Donald Trump's appeal of the verdict and judgment.

title: Melat Kiros projected to defeat Diana DeGette in Colorado Congressional primary
description: Challenger Melat Kiros, a democratic socialist, is the projected winner of the Democratic primary in Colorado's First Congressional District.

title: Incumbents Are Having a Rough Primary Season
description: Incumbent primary losses are piling up in the 2026 midterm elections.

title: World Cup cohosts Mexico beat Ecuador 2-0 to reach round of 16
description: Adverse weather does not dampen Mexico's party as the cohosts storm into the last 16 by beating Ecuador.

title: Tarik Skubal’s future isn’t in Detroit — but where he will land at trade deadline is an open question
description: The big question is where Tarik Skubal, who shut down the Yankees on one hit over six dominant innings Tuesday night, will be headed in a trade.

title: FBI determines ransom notes in Nancy Guthrie abduction are not genuine: report
description: Three ransom notes received from Nancy Guthrie’s so-called abductors following her chilling disappearance have been determined to be fake communications, according to a new report.

title: Socialist congressional candidate Melat Kiros defeats longtime Rep. Diana DeGette in Colorado Democratic primary in another blow to establishment
description: Kiros’s win in the solidly blue district follows a string of victories by socialist and far-left candidates over incumbent and establishment-backed Democrats in New York earlier this month, and it’s expected to tilt the political makeup of the House Democratic caucus even further to the left after the midterm elections.

title: Melat Kiros, a Left-Wing Insurgent, Ousts a 15-Term Congresswoman in Colorado
description: Melat Kiros, a 29-year-old democratic socialist, unseated Representative Diana DeGette in a Democratic primary to represent the Denver area.

title: Democratic socialist Melat Kiros unseats Rep. Diana DeGette in Colorado House primary
description: NBC News projects that Kiros, 29, defeated DeGette, who has been in Congress for three decades, in the latest victory for the insurgent left this primary season.

title: Raúl Jiménez: “Este equipo se hizo especial en el día a día”
description: Raúl Jiménez destacó la unión del grupo tras la victoria 2-0 sobre Ecuador y aseguró que México supo controlar el partido de principio a fin. El delantero celebró el pase a octavos y afirmó que el equipo va paso a paso en el Mundial.

title: Erick Lira: "No importa quién juegue, tratamos de demostrar lo que es México"
description: Erick Lira destacó la fortaleza del grupo tras la victoria sobre Ecuador que clasificó a México a los cuartos de final de la Copa Mundial de la FIFA 2026. El mediocampista aseguró que cualquier jugador está preparado para responder cuando le toca jugar.

title: Sebastián Beccacece agradece a Ecuador tras eliminación del Mundial
description: El técnico lamentó que Ecuador no pudo encontrar el gol ante México y se fue eliminado en la ronda de 16vos de final, tras una Copa del Mundo en donde al menos se van con el gran recuerdo de haber vencido a Alemania en fase de grupos.

title: ¡Piero Hincapié es expulsado por la nueva regla de la FIFA!
description: Piero Hincapié vio la tarjeta roja luego de decirle algo a Santiago Giménez con la mano cubriéndose la boca, acción que está prohibida por la nueva regla de la FIFA y que terminó dejando a Ecuador con un jugador menos ante México.

title: ¡Así vivió Javier Aguirre el triunfo de México sobre Ecuador!
description: Javier Aguirre no dejó de dar indicaciones durante todo el partido y celebró con emoción la victoria de México sobre Ecuador, resultado que selló el pase a los octavos de final de la Copa Mundial de la FIFA 2026.
